turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on am, is and are?
turns.tutor:
With no action word, use am, is or are.
Right: "The giraffe is very tall."
Wrong: "The giraffe very tall." It has no is, so it is wrong.
My example: "The zebra is black and white." One zebra is it, so I use is.
Now you. Write only the missing word, am, is or are:
I ___ a student.
